project.name: E-Commerce Platform
project.summary: Online marketplace for customers to browse, purchase, and track orders, with seller product management and admin oversight.

functional_requirements: Customers can browse the product catalogue
Customers can add products to a shopping cart
Customers can complete online payment and receive a receipt
Customers can track the status of their orders
Sellers can list products and manage inventory after admin approval
non_functional_requirements: The system must ensure data security and privacy
The platform must scale to support high traffic volumes
Response times for user actions should be under 2 seconds

actors.name: Customer
actors.description: Browse products, add items to cart, make purchases, and track orders

actors.name: Seller
actors.description: List products, update inventory, and fulfill orders after being approved

actors.name: Administrator
actors.description: Approve sellers, manage refunds, and oversee platform operations

use_cases.name: Browse Products
use_cases.description: Search and filter the product catalogue to view product details

use_cases.name: Add Product to Cart
use_cases.description: Select items and add them to a shopping cart for later checkout

use_cases.name: Checkout and Pay
use_cases.description: Enter payment information, complete the transaction, and receive a receipt

use_cases.name: List and Manage Products
use_cases.description: Create product listings, set prices, and update stock levels

use_cases.name: Approve Seller and Process Refund
use_cases.description: Validate seller applications and handle customer refund requests

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Customers can browse the product catalogue
criteria: Search results are displayed within 2 seconds
Filters and sorting work correctly for all categories

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Customers can add products to a shopping cart
criteria: Cart updates instantly after adding an item
Quantity cannot exceed available stock

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Customers can complete online payment and receive a receipt
criteria: Payment gateway returns success or failure within 5 seconds
A confirmation email with receipt is sent to the customer

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Sellers can list products and manage inventory after admin approval
criteria: New product listings appear in the catalogue within 1 minute
Inventory changes are reflected in real‑time for customers

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Administrators can approve sellers and handle refunds
criteria: Seller approval triggers an email notification
Refunds are processed and reflected in the system within 48 hours

user_stories.story: As a customer, I want to browse a product catalogue, so that I can find items to purchase.
acceptance_criteria: The catalogue displays product name, image, price, and stock status.
Customers can filter and sort products by category, price, and rating.

user_stories.story: As a customer, I want to add products to a cart, so that I can purchase multiple items in one order.
acceptance_criteria: Items can be added, updated quantity, or removed from the cart.
Cart persists across user sessions until checkout or manual clearing.

user_stories.story: As a customer, I want to pay online securely, so that my transaction is safe and completed quickly.
acceptance_criteria: Payment gateway supports credit/debit cards and tokenized payments with SSL encryption.
Transaction status is confirmed and displayed to the user immediately.

user_stories.story: As a seller, I want to list products after approval, so that I can sell items on the platform.
acceptance_criteria: Approved sellers can create, edit, and delete product listings with images and inventory levels.
Listings become visible to customers only after the seller is approved by an administrator.

user_stories.story: As an administrator, I want to approve sellers, so that only vetted vendors can sell on the platform.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can view seller applications and approve or reject them.
Sellers receive notification of approval status via email.

user_stories.story: As an administrator, I want to handle refund requests, so that customers receive timely resolutions.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can view, approve, or deny refund requests with reason codes.
Customers are notified of the refund decision and status updates.

Database Designer.sql:
CREATE TABLE users (
    user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name TEXT,
    email TEXT,
    password_hash TEXT,
    is_admin BOOLEAN
);

CREATE TABLE sellers (
    seller_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id INTEGER,
    store_name TEXT,
    approved BOOLEAN,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE products (
    product_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    seller_id INTEGER,
    name TEXT,
    description TEXT,
    price REAL,
    stock INTEGER,
    FOREIGN KEY (seller_id) REFERENCES sellers(seller_id)
);

CREATE TABLE orders (
    order_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    user_id INTEGER,
    order_date DATETIME,
    total_amount REAL,
    status TEXT,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id)
);

Add a product to the customer's shopping cart
Create an order and process payment
Retrieve order details and tracking information
Process a refund request for an order

Project Structure.architecture: Micro‑service style with a single FastAPI service handling authentication, product, cart, order and admin APIs. React/Vite SPA consumes these APIs. PostgreSQL stores relational data; Redis provides session caching and async task queue (Celery). Docker composes services; Nginx terminates TLS and load‑balances. Stripe integration for payments, JWT for auth, and background workers process refunds and order notifications.
Project Structure.architecture_diagram:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Client
        A[React SPA] -->|REST/JSON| B[FastAPI Gateway]
    end
    subgraph Services
        B --> C[Auth Service]
        B --> D[Product Service]
        B --> E[Cart Service]
        B --> F[Order Service]
        B --> G[Admin Service]
    end
    C --> H[PostgreSQL]
    D --> H
    E --> H
    F --> H
    G --> H
    F --> I[Redis Cache]
    F --> J[Celery Workers]
    J --> K[RabbitMQ]
    F --> L[Stripe API]
    G --> M[Refund Queue]
    M --> J
    style A fill:#f9f,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    style B fill:#bbf,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px

Documentation.readme: E‑Commerce Platform enables customers to browse catalogs, add items to a cart, checkout with online payments, and track orders. Sellers register, await admin approval, then list products and manage inventory. Admins approve sellers, oversee refunds, and monitor system health. Built with Node.js, Express, React, PostgreSQL, and Stripe. Emphasizes security, scalability, and performance.
Documentation.api_documentation: POST /api/auth/login – user auth, returns JWT. POST /api/sellers/register – submit seller info. GET /api/sellers/:id/status – approval status. POST /api/products – admin‑approved seller adds product. GET /api/products – list with filters. POST /api/cart – add item, requires JWT. POST /api/orders – create order, payment via Stripe. GET /api/orders/:id – order status. POST /api/refunds – admin processes refund.
Documentation.installation: Clone repo, run `npm install` in server and client directories. Set env vars: DB_URL, JWT_SECRET, STRIPE_KEY, ADMIN_EMAIL. Initialize PostgreSQL schema with `npm run migrate`. Seed admin user with `npm run seed`. Start server `npm start` and client `npm run start`. Use Docker compose for full stack.
Documentation.deployment: Containerize with Docker. Use multi‑stage build for Node server and React static files. Deploy to Kubernetes or AWS ECS with autoscaling. Configure PostgreSQL RDS and Redis cache. Set up CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions) to run tests, build images, and push to registry. Use Nginx as reverse proxy with TLS.
Documentation.sprint_plan: Sprint 1: Core user auth, product catalog API, UI list. Sprint 2: Cart, checkout integration with Stripe, order tracking. Sprint 3: Seller registration workflow, admin approval UI, inventory CRUD. Sprint 4: Refund handling, admin dashboard, security hardening. Sprint 5: Load testing, CI/CD, monitoring, documentation.
Documentation.architecture: Frontend: React SPA with Redux, communicates via REST over HTTPS. Backend: Node.js/Express microservice layer, JWT auth, business logic. Data: PostgreSQL for relational data, Redis for session cache. Payments: Stripe API. Messaging: RabbitMQ for async order processing. Deployed on Docker/K8s with horizontal pod autoscaling and load balancer.
